### List

```go
func (s *FileService) List(
	ctx context.Context,
) (*Response[FileListResponse], error)
```

List stored files.

List all files stored in the Object Store.

It sends `GET /api/file`, and needs the permission `file:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

List stored files, `go run file.go list`:

```go
resp, err := c.File.List(ctx)
```

### Stale

```go
func (s *FileService) Stale(
	ctx context.Context,
) (*Response[StaleDeploymentsResponse], error)
```

List stale file deployments.

Returns deployments where the source object in the Object Store has been updated
since the file was last deployed. Controller-only check that compares state KV
SHA-256 hashes against current object content.

It sends `GET /api/file/stale`, and needs the permission `file:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

List stale file deployments, `go run file.go stale`:

```go
resp, err := c.File.Stale(ctx)
```

### Upload

```go
func (s *FileService) Upload(
	ctx context.Context,
	name string,
	contentType string,
	file io.Reader,
) (*Response[FileUploadResponse], error)
```

Upload creates a file in the Object Store. It computes the SHA-256 of the
content first, and skips the upload when the stored file has the same content. A
file with other content is a ConflictError: Update replaces it.

The examples of the method's definition:

Upload a file, `go run file.go upload`:

```go
content, err := os.ReadFile("/tmp/app.conf")
if err != nil {
	return err
}

resp, err := c.File.Upload(ctx, "app.conf", "raw", bytes.NewReader(content))
```

Upload a file, with --name app.conf.tmpl --file /tmp/app.conf.tmpl
--content-type template, `go run file.go upload-2`:

```go
content, err := os.ReadFile("/tmp/app.conf.tmpl")
if err != nil {
	return err
}

resp, err := c.File.Upload(ctx, "app.conf.tmpl", "template", bytes.NewReader(content))
```

### GetChanged

```go
func (s *FileService) GetChanged(
	ctx context.Context,
	name string,
	file io.Reader,
) (*Response[FileChanged], error)
```

GetChanged computes the SHA-256 of the content and compares it with the SHA-256
of the stored file. Changed is true when the content differs, or the file does
not exist yet.

It is not an operation of the API: it runs in the client.
